experiment: Center-out transport, all nine visually assigned spatial targets, both separate hand sessions; use measurement Vicon (unrotated optical marker positions).
participant_rule: All 31 participants in full archive; the article reports numbering by age. Every fourth ID (4,8,12,16,20,24,28) is sealed, distributing holdouts across the ordered list. The other 24 form development.
trial_rule: Select the first two assignments of every target per participant-hand in session recording order, then drop author exclusions or unusable series with explicit reasons. Never backfill missed trials.
public_rule: Development participant 01, first assigned trial for every target and each hand, after the same exclusions. No substitutions.
missingness_rule: Retain original frame grid and represent absent measurements explicitly. Determine stable within-trial marker membership from start-frame availability to prevent switching on dropouts. No extrapolation or post-trial alignment for predictive inputs.
evaluation_scope: The seven listed people formed a participant-disjoint test set for the two prespecified clocks.
